purpose: Test whether the replicated venue/circumference heterogeneity survives on meeting IDs fully disjoint from both existing 100-race batches, without retuning.
selection_rule: Read .github/workflows/races.csv and extract every seed meeting ID.
Read .github/workflows/races_temporal_replication_100_v1.csv if present and extract every temporal-replication meeting ID.
Enumerate candidate meeting IDs deterministically across 2026-07-01 through 2026-07-31, date ascending then venue code ascending.
Exclude every meeting ID seen in either prior 100-race batch.
For each remaining candidate meeting ID enumerate day indices 01,02,03 then race numbers 01..12.
Probe PRE racecard parsing only during selection; result and payout endpoints are forbidden until exactly 100 complete PRE candidates are frozen.
Take the first 100 candidates with complete mandatory Frozen B1a PRE fields. No result-dependent replacement, venue quota, favorable-circumference filter or post-hoc deletion.
Freeze all 100 PRE inputs and predictions before dedicated result scoring.
If fewer than 100 complete PRE candidates exist in the fixed window, fail closed and report the maximum available set rather than widening the date window after seeing outcomes.
primary_comparisons_preregistered: Overall top1 accuracy, winner Top3 rate and multiclass log loss versus both prior 100-race batches.
Whether Aomori and Kawasaki remain relatively strong and Gifu and Yahiko remain relatively weak when represented.
Whether exact 333.3m remains the weakest circumference group when represented.
